question.text: How much solid oxalic acid (Molecular weight 126 ) has to be weighed to prepare $100 \mathrm{~mL}$ exactly $0.1$ (N) oxalic acid solution in water?

solution.text:
$\mathrm{n}_{\mathrm{eq}}=\mathrm{N} \times \mathrm{V}(\mathrm{L})$
$=(0.1)\left(\frac{100}{1000}\right)=0.01$
weight $=$ no. of eq $\left(n_{e q}\right) \times$ Equivalent mass $=0.01 \times \frac{126}{2}=0.63 \mathrm{~g}$
